newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee called to open flat to 1.00 lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee called to open flat to 1.00 lower.

text.p: CSCE coffee futures were called to open unchanged to 1.00 cent per lb lower on Monday, dealers said.
The head of Colombia's main truck drivers' union said talks with the government would resume today to end a strike that began at midnight Saturday.
CSCE coffee futures closed higher on Friday for the third consecutive day, buoyed by concern over the high open interest in May and the low level of deliverable stocks.
CSCE warehouse stocks fell 16 percent to 67,578 60-kg bags as of April 16.
Tuesday is the first notice day for the May contract.

May coffee ended up 6.75 cents at 216.55 cents a pound, after seeing a new contract high early at 218.00 cents. CSCE July coffee ended up 6.65 cents at 194.15 cents, after seeing a session high at 194.50 cents.

Technically, daily momentum oscillators remain positive while a standard five day slow stochastic is overbought around 82 percent, suggesting another downward correction is possible, technical analysts said.
In London LIFFE coffee futures were higher by the midday break, with benchmark July up $36 at $1,698. Resistance was pegged at $1,700.
